question: Does the Doubao drive free capacity remain 5 TB time-limited, or has it been reduced to 10GB for new accounts with 5TB retained on older ones?
why: The first-party drive page returned a chat redirect with no capacity text, and a forum comparison table read on 2026-11-19 says 10GB for new accounts with 5TB+ on old ones and calls the figure doubtful because the UI shows no total. The earlier 5T/50G forum post was not available on 2026-11-19.
